messaging.channel.mlsResetArchiveNote: A local copy of your previous MLS keys is kept on this device for about one week for troubleshooting. Until an upgraded admin restores you (or you abandon the old channel after re-creating), those keys can still work on the live group if someone obtains that copy. Deleting the archive later does not revoke them.
messaging.channel.mlsResetMultipleAdmins: A security upgrade reset this channel’s local encryption state. Ask one of the last admins recorded on this device to open Members and choose Restore access for you:
messaging.channel.mlsResetNoAdminRecord: A security upgrade reset this channel’s local encryption state, but this device has no record of an admin who can restore it. Contact the squad and arrange a new invitation or re-create the squad.
messaging.channel.mlsResetRolloutNote: Upgrade co-admins one at a time. At least one admin must stay on the previous app version (still holding group state) to restore the others. If every admin upgrades first, this squad cannot be restored and must be re-created.
messaging.channel.mlsResetSingleAdminOth: This squad had only one admin, so it cannot be restored after the upgrade. The last admin recorded on this device must re-create the squad and invite members again. Prefer the new squad and stop using the old channel.
messaging.channel.mlsResetSingleAdminSel: You were the only admin recorded for this squad. No other admin can restore it after the upgrade; re-create the squad and invite its members again. Prefer the new squad and stop using this channel afterward.
messaging.channel.mlsResetTitle: This channel needs to be restored
messaging.channel.mlsRestoreConfirmBody: Use this only if {name} lost channel access after the security upgrade. It replaces their old group credentials with a fresh invite.
messaging.channel.mlsRestoreSuccess: Restore started for {name}. They should regain the composer after accepting the welcome.
messaging.channel.mlsWelcomeBody: Your decryptable MLS history starts here. Messages from before you joined can’t be decrypted on this device—that’s how MLS works, not a sync failure. New messages in this group will appear below.
